resources.string: One tap saves the link you copied.
Round checkboxes on photos and videos in any app

Tap the floating Lodi in any app and a round checkbox shows on each photo and video. When you tick one, LodiSave presses that post\'s Share and Copy link for you, so it can save the original file, and keeps a picture of it as it shows on screen for apps that give no link. It looks at the screen only while you\'re picking, and sends nothing anywhere but to the sites you save from.
